image_description: A dark blue and white minibus parked on a gravel surface. The vehicle features a boxy shape, a large front windshield, side windows, and visible text/logos on the side and front. A portion of another blue vehicle is visible in the bottom right foreground.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic compact, high-roof silhouette of a minibus, distinct from full-size buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible, and multiple side windows are present along the passenger cabin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has significant height relative to its width. A sliding door track/handle mechanism is visible on the side, consistent with a mid-body entrance.
The panel lines and handle on the side indicate a sliding door mechanism typical of this vehicle class.
The short hood and grille arrangement at the front indicate the location of the engine compartment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the frame; only the front three-quarters are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a two-tone blue and white livery with visible text/logos ('go', 'COURTESY CARS'), fitting the description of company livery.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel is proportional to a standard van/minibus, with a realistic rim structure.
The window configuration and overall size are consistent with a vehicle designed for small group transport.

artifact_observations.location: Side of the vehicle, near the sliding door
artifact_observations.reasoning: The white text/logo on the side appears to spell 'go' but the letters are slightly malformed and fused with the background texture, lacking sharp typographic edges.
The characters on the front license plate are illegible and distorted, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than clear alphanumeric characters.
Reflections on the windshield are somewhat smeared and lack the crisp definition of real glass reflections, blending into the interior details.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific make/model classification and ensure it aligns with the 'minibus' taxonomy.
To rigorously analyze the legibility and structural correctness of the text on the side and the license plate, which showed signs of gibberish.
To check for edge bleeding between the vehicle and the background, and ensure the wheels are topologically connected to the chassis without floating artifacts.
To assess general coherence, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle global artifacts missed by specific auditors.

focus_areas: Text legibility on license plate and side logos
Edge sharpness between vehicle and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the license plate and side text. AI generators often fail here. If the text auditor confirms illegibility or nonsensical character structures, this is a significant artifact. Also, verify if the wheel rim spokes are physically plausible and symmetric, as AI often distorts radial symmetry in wheels.
